facts.fact: The Council of Ministers' communique of 8 October 2026 describes a text on digital payments, taken in line with CEMAC rules on payment systems, means and services, that consolidates the national legal framework for digital payments; the extract does not say whether it is a bill, ordinance or decree, so it is recorded as a text before the Council (date is the communique's).
facts.system: Gabon digital payments text (Council of Ministers, 8 October 2026)

facts.fact: The communique of 8 October 2026 says the text is made in accordance with the CEMAC regulation on payment systems, means and services, treated as the existing regional framework; it gives no year for that regulation and the date is the communique's.
facts.system: CEMAC regulation on payment systems, means and services

facts.fact: The communique of 8 October 2026 says the text provides for the State to run communication and financial-education programmes with payment institutions (etablissements de paiement), and that it governs the supply of payment solutions in the country; the text's form is not stated.
facts.system: Gabon digital payments text (Council of Ministers, 8 October 2026)
